description: List currently active flash-sale deals from Heartly merchants (see merchant_verified per deal). Returns deals sorted by ending soonest. Filters are optional and combinable.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Filters to merchants whose shipping_countries include this code, plus merchants who ship worldwide.

ending_within_hours.description: Only return deals ending within this many hours from now.

min_discount_pct.description: Minimum discount percentage. Only return deals at or above this value.

name: list_active_deals
title: List active deals
